no_authorized_users.title: Nobody can use {entry_title}
no_authorized_users.description: Discord Assist only answers Discord users it can run as a Home Assistant user. Open the integration options and add a Discord-to-Home-Assistant user mapping, or set allowed Discord user IDs plus a fallback Home Assistant user. Until then the bot ignores every message.

message_content_intent.title: {entry_title} needs the Message Content intent
message_content_intent.description: Discord refused the gateway connection because the bot does not have the Message Content privileged intent. Enable it under Bot > Privileged Gateway Intents in the Discord Developer Portal, then reload the integration.
